title: Service Closure Confirmation and the Early Closure Fee — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Desk Tool Reference
content:
## Closure of the service

This rule settles the early closure fee owed when an employer closes its Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service before the end of its minimum term. A closure takes effect only on the in-person confirmation of the employer contact who submitted the pending service-closure request, whose role must be listed among the tier's authorized requester roles; a recall is accepted only from a requester whose role is listed among the tier's authorized requester roles. On every tier those roles are program owner and payroll admin.

Closing the service is the employer's own act: once the desk has quoted the early closure fee, that contact confirms the closure, and the confirmation closes the service on the closing date, marks the closure request confirmed and debits the early closure fee in the same step; the desk books no withdrawal on the closing day, and the remaining prefund balance is returned to the employer's bank by the closing run on the next business day.

For a service whose tier carries a monthly platform fee, the early closure fee is fixed only after the ledger carries the platform fee for the month in which the closure falls. Put the other way: where the tier's monthly platform fee is above zero, the early closure fee is not fixed while the service's ledger shows no platform fee entry for the month of the closing date.

## Confirming the closure

The closure is confirmed with `confirm_service_closure_f3d256bb`, a tool the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the employer's authorized contact who submitted the closure request runs it in person.

**Capability.** The employer's authorized contact confirms, in person, the closure of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service against its pending service-closure request. One call sets the service's status to closed with today's date as its closing date, marks that closure request confirmed, and debits the early closure fee quoted by the desk from the prefund balance as an early-closure fee entry; when the fee given is zero no fee entry is booked. After the call the employer sees the service closed, payouts stopped and any fee on its ledger.

### Parameters

- `disburse_service_id` — the reference number of the employer's Instant Pay Disbursement service, as read to the employer by the desk from the service record (identifier).
- `disburse_request_id` — the reference number of the employer's pending service-closure request, as read to the employer by the desk from the request record (identifier).
- `early_closure_fee` — the early closure fee the desk quoted, in US dollars as a number with exactly 2 decimal places, zero or greater; a value with more decimals is rounded half up to the cent before booking.

### Return

- A one-line confirmation naming the service reference (text), its new status (closed), the closing date (YYYY-MM-DD), the closure request reference (text) with its new status (confirmed), the fee entry reference (text, or "none" when the fee was zero), the fee debited (US dollars, two decimals) and the prefund balance after the debit (US dollars, two decimals). The status closed being reported means the closure took effect.
- A message beginning "Not confirmed" means the fee given was below zero and nothing changed.

### Contract illustration (hypothetical values)

An `early_closure_fee` of 88.888 debits 88.89; an `early_closure_fee` of 0 closes the service and books no fee entry, the fee entry being reported as "none".
